caption: The drawing depicts three objects arranged on a plain, off-white background. The objects are rendered in shades of brown, tan, cream, and touches of blue and green. The topmost object is a cylindrical, stick-like item with a slightly rounded end, decorated with cream-colored, embroidered patterns and small blue-green dot accents. The middle object appears to be a pouch or bag attached to a long strap or sheath; it is mainly brown and tan, with visible stitching and cream embroidery forming circular and floral shapes, as well as several blue and green embroidered details. The pouch-like section on the left side is secured with stitches and has a worn, slightly wrinkled appearance. The third object at the bottom resembles a sheath, also brown with cream embroidery that includes another floral pattern at one end and a leafy chain along its length, with a blue and green accent at the wide end. The drawing is labeled at the bottom left “A 3582 - 28,” and the name “LYMAN YOUNG” is written at the bottom right.
title: Embroidered Leather Scabbard
